INSERT INTO sys_dict_type ( id, tenant_id, code, kind, source, name_key, name_labels, status, sort_order, source_ref, deleted ) VALUES
( #{type.id}, NULL, #{type.code}, #{type.kind}, #{type.source}, #{type.nameKey}, CAST(#{type.nameLabels} AS JSONB), #{type.status}, #{type.sortOrder}, #{type.sourceRef}, #{type.deleted} )
ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET kind = EXCLUDED.kind, source = EXCLUDED.source, name_key = EXCLUDED.name_key, name_labels = EXCLUDED.name_labels, status = EXCLUDED.status, source_ref = EXCLUDED.source_ref, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = sys_dict_type.version + 1, deleted = EXCLUDED.deleted WHERE sys_dict_type.kind IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.kind OR sys_dict_type.source IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.source OR sys_dict_type.name_key IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.name_key OR sys_dict_type.name_labels IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.name_labels OR sys_dict_type.status IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.status OR sys_dict_type.source_ref IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.source_ref OR sys_dict_type.deleted IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.deleted

( #{item.id}, #{item.dictTypeId}, #{item.itemValue}, #{item.source}, #{item.sourceRef}, #{item.labelKey}, CAST(#{item.labelLabels} AS JSONB), #{item.tone}, #{item.selectable}, #{item.status}, #{item.sortOrder}, #{item.deleted} )
ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET source = EXCLUDED.source, source_ref = EXCLUDED.source_ref, label_key = EXCLUDED.label_key, label_labels = EXCLUDED.label_labels, tone = EXCLUDED.tone, selectable = EXCLUDED.selectable, status = EXCLUDED.status, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = sys_dict_item.version + 1, deleted = EXCLUDED.deleted WHERE sys_dict_item.source IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.source OR sys_dict_item.source_ref IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.source_ref OR sys_dict_item.label_key IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.label_key OR sys_dict_item.label_labels IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.label_labels OR sys_dict_item.tone IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.tone OR sys_dict_item.selectable IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.selectable OR sys_dict_item.status IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.status OR sys_dict_item.deleted IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.deleted
